description: Seven terminal coding agents through their npm and PyPI names, each run once so it writes its state directory.
why: Most of these agents have two witnesses here, a package and a state directory, so must_contain names each. Amp and Crush write no top-level directory, so their npm row is the only witness. Qwen Code is a Gemini CLI fork and Crush was opencode-ai/opencode before its rename, so gemini-cli and opencode are forbidden; claude-code and codex-cli are forbidden because ~/.local/bin and top-level home directories are their routes too.
known_gaps: Amp's and Droid's curl installers (ampcode.com/install.sh, app.factory.ai/cli), Junie's (junie.jetbrains.com/install.sh) and Charm's apt and yum repositories are not exercised, and no value was read from them.
Editor extensions are not installed: Amp's VS Code extension, Qwen Code's IDE companion and Junie's JetBrains plugin.
